requirement: Multi-source data (>=3, incl. identity/access and network/OT)
what_was_done: IIoT telemetry, network flows, identity/access, ticket text, ATT&CK ICS text, plus asset/user context.
remaining_work: Access log and tickets are synthetic; this must be stated in the report and defence.

what_was_done: Provenance hashes, quality findings, role/user/telemetry/network baselines.
remaining_work: Network flow source has no timestamp column, so time-based joins to it are not possible.

what_was_done: Confusion matrices, precision, recall, F1, ROC-AUC, PR-AUC, permutation importance.
remaining_work: Scores on ToN_IoT are high because the capture is a controlled testbed.

what_was_done: Case ranked from evidence, entities identified, four-phase response plan.
remaining_work: The case is an analytical scenario built on synthetic access data, clearly labelled.

what_was_done: Operational watchlist for the SOC and an executive brief with modelled effects.
remaining_work: ATT&CK mapping is TF-IDF similarity, not an analyst-validated mapping.

what_was_done: Monte Carlo propagation over the asset graph with Wilson confidence intervals.
remaining_work: Transmission probabilities are assumed; only p_foothold is measured from data.

what_was_done: Preprocessing, TF-IDF classification with a confusion matrix, indicator extraction scored against an answer key, NMF topics, ATT&CK enrichment.
remaining_work: Ticket text is template-generated, so classification accuracy is optimistic.

what_was_done: Six-component interpretable score with bands, next-day early warning, and drift/evasion/missing-data/poisoning tests.
remaining_work: Next-day forecast is weak (ROC-AUC ~0.53); reported as a negative result.

what_was_done: Analyst can inspect events, baselines, anomalies, model results, risk, the incident and the intelligence products.
